company.name: Amulyte
company.shortDescription: Amulyte is an activity tracking and emergency response system that allows seniors to maintain their freedom and independence.
company.description:
Amulyte is an activity tracking and emergency response system designed to allow seniors to keep their freedom and independence while providing peace of mind to family members and caregivers.

The Amulyte device, worn by a senior, tracks activity and contains a help button that automatically alerts caregivers in the event of an emergency. The device works anywhere and is location, making help accessible anywhere.

The Amulyte Portal is an online web app allowing family members and caregivers to stay connected and informed.
